title: DK Essentials
description: DKEssentials is a lightweight, fully configurable essentials plugin for Paper/Spigot 1.21+ that streamlines server management, enhances player quality-of-life, and integrates seamlessly with PlaceholderAPI, mcMMO, and modern in‑game GUIs
body:
**DKEssentials** — Essential utilities for modern Paper/Spigot (1.21+)
A lightweight, configurable plugin that streamlines server management and player QoL with protection rules, world/gameplay controls, polished GUIs, and seamless integrations.

**Key commands (selection)**
- Admin
  - /clearchat — clear chat for all
  - /invsee <player> — view target inventory
  - /god [player], /heal [player], /gamemode <mode> [player]
  - /giveall [item] [amount] — item selector GUI if no args
  - /spawner <player|all> [entity] [amount] — entity selector GUI if missing
  - /summon <player> [entity] [amount] — paginated entity selector + chat amount
  - /title, /actionbar, /alert[a]/alertapv — broadcast tools
  - /cmds — GUI to toggle plugin commands
- Player
  - /tpa, /tpaccept, /tpdeny, /tptoggle
  - /warp, /setwarp, /delwarp, /back, /top, /randomtp
  - /anvil, /craft, /echest, /lixo, /hat, /ping, /near
  - /enchant — GUI to pick enchant; level via chat
  - /potion — GUI to pick type; toggle strength/duration

Note: Many commands respect per‑world rules, cooldowns, and UX flows.

**Permissions (high level)**
- dkessentials.* — full access (admin + player)
- dkessentials.admin — core admin tools (god/heal/clearchat/gamemode/version)
- dkessentials.player — player utilities (tpa/tpaccept/tptoggle, etc.)
- Bypass examples: dkessentials.bypass.chatfilter, dkessentials.bypass.gamemode, dkessentials.bypass.clearchat

**Compatibility**
- Server: Paper/Spigot 1.21+
- PlaceholderAPI (optional) placeholders:
  - %dkessentials_online%, %dkessentials_online_staff%
  - %dkessentials_vanish_status%, %dkessentials_vanish_quantia%
  - %dkessentials_kitcooldown_[kit]%
- mcMMO (optional): listener support
- LegendChat/nChat (optional): chat integration
